source_data.desc:
This massive purple creature, with legs like tree trunks and a pair of enormous arms, shakes the ground with its footsteps. Its eyeless head is bulbous, with an elongated mouth that is almost snout-like._  
**Allies of the Ghasts of Leng.** The kaveph are massive creatures that originate from the lightless underground of the  
**Plateau of Leng.** They are usually found in the company of the Open Game License
source_data.name: Kaveph
source_data.reactions_json: [{"name": "Revenge", "desc": "When a kaveph is dealt 20 damage or more by a single attack and survives, it can make a smash attack against the attacker."}]
source_data.senses: blindsight 90 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 10
source_data.special_abilities_json: [{"name": "Rampage", "desc": "When the kaveph reduces a creature to 0 hp with a melee attack on its turn, it can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make a smash attack."}]

ru.description:
Это массивное фиолетовое существо, с ногами, как стволы деревьев, и парой огромных рук, трясёт землю своими шагами. Его безглазая голова луковичная, с удлинённым ртом, который почти походит на рыло.

**Союзники гастов Ленга.** Кавефы — массивные существа, которые происходят из лишённого света подземелья Плато Ленг.
ru.name: Кавеф
